qs.q: Which of the following examples describes the socio-emotional dimension?
opts: Watching a mobile swing above a crib
An infant smiling from her mother's touch
Height and weight gains, development of the brain
Creating a two-word sentence, memorizing a poem
qs.ex: البُعد الاجتماعي العاطفي (socio-emotional) يعني مشاعر وتفاعل مع الناس، زي رضيعة بتضحك لما مامتها تلمسها. باقي الاختيارات: الطول والوزن نمو جسدي، والكلام والحفظ معرفي ولغوي.

qs.q: Development is defined as:
opts: An increase in competence and adaptability
Qualitative change in child's function and capability
Quantitative change in child's body and physiology
qs.ex: الـ Development تغيّر نوعي (qualitative) في وظايف الطفل وقدراته. أما التغيّر الكمي في الجسم (quantitative) فده growth.

qs.q: Which of the following needs is essential for infant development?
qs.ex: أهم احتياج للرضيع: الحب والأمان (love and security).

qs.q: Which one of the following developmental needs is essential for school-age children?
qs.ex: طفل سن المدرسة محتاج يتعلم القواعد (learning rules).

qs.q: Developmental stage is defined as:
opts: A fixed period that has a well-defined time limit
A specific period expected for physiologic changes
A specific way that describes the route of maturity
A variable period in which a specific task must be mastered
qs.ex: المرحلة التطورية فترة مش ثابتة (variable)، والطفل لازم يتقن فيها مهمة معينة.

qs.q: Communication is considered a dimension of development. (True / False)
qs.ex: صح. التواصل (communication) بُعد من أبعاد التطور.

qs.q: Cephalocaudal direction is from the center of the body outward to peripheral parts. (True / False)
qs.ex: غلط. الـ Cephalocaudal معناه من الراس للرجلين. أما من المركز للأطراف فده proximodistal.

qs.q: Which of the following is NOT TRUE about growth?
opts: Weight is the best indicator of growth
It is physical changes and increase in size
Its rate is rapid during adolescence
Its rate is slow during the infancy period
qs.ex: الغلط: إن النمو بطيء في الرضاعة. بالعكس، النمو في الـ infancy أسرع حاجة.

qs.q: Growth & development starts as a general process before it becomes specific. (True / False)
qs.ex: صح. النمو والتطور بيبدأ عام وبعدين يبقى محدد (general to specific).

qs.q: Which of the following statements is correct about growth and development?
opts: All children grow at the same rate
Growth usually proceeds from complex to simple tasks
Almost all the stages are not critical
The sequence of each stage is predictable
qs.ex: ترتيب المراحل ثابت ومتوقع (predictable)، حتى لو كل طفل ليه سرعته.

qs.q: Which of the following is correct about the toddler period? It is the time of:
qs.ex: الـ toddler مرحلة استكشاف مكثف (intensive exploration).

qs.q: Punishment can help stop a toddler's temper tantrum. (True / False)
qs.ex: غلط. العقاب مش بيوقّف نوبات الغضب عند الـ toddler. الأحسن نتجاهلها بهدوء ونحافظ على أمانه.

qs.q: The correct term that describes the process of increasing the child's physical size is ......
qs.ex: زيادة الحجم الجسدي اسمها Growth.

qs.q: Which of the following statements is correct about growth and development?
opts: Almost all the stages are not critical
All children grow at the same rate
Growth proceeds from complex to simple tasks
Sequence of growth and development is predictable
qs.ex: تسلسل النمو والتطور متوقع (predictable).

qs.q: Proximodistal law means that growth starts from ......
qs.ex: الـ Proximodistal معناه من المركز للأطراف (center to peripheral).

qs.q: What is the correct term that describes the process of increasing the child's physical size?
qs.ex: زيادة الحجم الجسدي اسمها Growth.

qs.q: Which of the following is a statement about normal growth and development on which effective nursing care is based?
opts: Growth occurs at the same rates for individuals
Development starts with complex and progresses to simple tasks
Individual's growth and development are difficult to predict
Success in one phase of growth and development affects later phases
qs.ex: النجاح في مرحلة بيأثر على المراحل اللي بعدها. أما باقي الاختيارات فغلط: كل واحد ليه سرعته، والتطور بيبدأ بسيط وبعدين يبقى معقد، وهو predictable.

qs.q: Which of the following is considered development?
qs.ex: الـ Communication من التطور. الوزن والطول ومحيط الراس مقاييس نمو.

qs.q: Which of the following developmental needs is essential for the infant?
qs.ex: الرضيع محتاج الحب والأمان.

qs.q: Which of the following is considered a dimension of development?
qs.ex: الـ Communication بُعد من أبعاد التطور.

qs.q: The most influencing factor on growth and development is:
qs.ex: أكتر عامل مؤثر: الوراثة (Heredity). هي اللي بتحدد إمكانيات النمو، والبيئة بتعدّل فيها.

qs.q: Proximodistal law means that growth starts from: مصادر5 تكرر في
qs.ex: الـ Proximodistal من المركز للأطراف. السؤال ده متكرر في 5 مصادر.

qs.q: Children generally double their birth weight by 5 months of age. This is an example of:
qs.ex: إن الطفل يضاعف وزنه في 5 شهور ده نمو جسدي (physical growth).

qs.q: Proximodistal law means that growth starts from: مصادر5 تكرر في
qs.ex: الـ Proximodistal من المركز للأطراف.

qs.q: The process of an individual's capacities quantitatively should be termed as:
qs.ex: الزيادة الكمية اسمها Growth.

qs.q: In which stage is the child constantly rebelling and has temper tantrums?
qs.ex: الـ Toddler هو اللي دايماً بيتمرد وعنده نوبات غضب (temper tantrums).

qs.q: Which of the following principles of development is INCORRECT?
qs.ex: الغلط إن التطور عملية متقطعة. التطور عملية مستمرة (continuous).

qs.q: Which of the following is considered a dimension of changes in growth?
qs.ex: الـ Physiological بُعد من أبعاد النمو. أما المعرفي والتواصل والمفردات فدي أبعاد تطور.

qs.q: Children who are taller for their age during early childhood years are taller during adulthood also. By this observation which principle of development is proved?
opts: Development is the product of maturation and learning
Early development is more important than later development
qs.ex: الطفل الطويل في الطفولة بيطلع طويل وهو كبير، وده معناه إن التطور predictable.

qs.q: Which of the following developmental needs is essential for a five-year-old child?
qs.ex: طفل 5 سنين محتاج يتعلم اللغة.

qs.q: What is the correct answer that describes the process of increasing the child's physical size?
qs.ex: زيادة الحجم الجسدي: Growth.

qs.q: Proximodistal law means that growth starts from:
qs.ex: الـ Proximodistal: من المركز للأطراف.

qs.q: In which of the following stages does the child have temper tantrums and use the word "No"?
qs.ex: الـ Toddler بيعمل temper tantrums وبيقول «لأ» كتير.

qs.q: Which principle of growth and development indicates that growth begins from the head to the feet?
opts: Growth goes from general to specific
qs.ex: من الراس للرجلين: Cephalocaudal.

qs.q: The process of physical changes of individuals quantitatively should be termed as:
qs.ex: التغيرات الجسدية الكمية: Growth.

qs.q: When improvement occurs in structure and function first in the head region, then in the trunk, and last in the leg region, this represents which principle of growth and development?
qs.ex: التحسن بيبدأ في الراس وبعدين الجذع وبعدين الرجلين: Cephalocaudal.

qs.q: Which of the following examples describes the socio-emotional dimension?
opts: Watching a mobile swing above a crib
qs.ex: أول ضحكة للطفل ده بُعد اجتماعي عاطفي.

qs.q: Which principle explains the process when an infant grasps an object with the whole hand then uses the forefingers in grasping?
qs.ex: الطفل بيمسك بإيده كلها وبعدين بصوابعه: General to specific. خلي بالك: التصحيح في الورقة الأصلية كان proximodistal، فممكن تلاقي الإجابتين.

qs.q: A mother says her son walked before he could pick up small objects with his fingers. Which principle explains this?
qs.ex: الطفل مشي قبل ما يعرف يمسك حاجات صغيرة بصوابعه. حسب البنك ده Proximodistal: التحكم في الجذع والأطراف الكبيرة بييجي قبل الصوابع.

qs.q: Which is an example of DEVELOPMENT rather than growth?
qs.ex: الـ Development تغيّر نوعي في المهارات، زي إن الطفل يتعلم يتكلم جمل. الوزن والطول ومحيط الراس growth.

qs.q: Select ALL principles of growth and development.
opts: Each child has an individual rate
Development is the product of maturation and learning
qs.ex: مبادئ النمو: cephalocaudal، وgeneral to specific، وكل طفل ليه سرعته، والتطور نتيجة النضج والتعلم. التسلسل نفسه predictable، مش unpredictable.

qs.q: Which factor is considered the most influential on growth and development?
qs.ex: الوراثة أكتر عامل مؤثر.

qs.q: Height increases faster in which seasons?
qs.ex: الطول بيزيد أسرع في الربيع والصيف، والوزن في الخريف والشتا.

qs.q: The period of most rapid growth after birth is:
qs.ex: أسرع نمو بعد الولادة في الـ infancy (أول سنة).

qs.q: According to Piaget's cognitive theory, when 10-year-old children can solve visual problems better than verbal, it is termed the ...... period.
qs.ex: طفل عنده 10 سنين بيحل المسائل المرئية أحسن من الكلامية، يعني بيفكر في الحاجات الملموسة. ده Concrete operational (7–11).

qs.q: A child is able to use inductive reasoning during the age of ...... years.
qs.ex: الـ Inductive reasoning بيبان في مرحلة الـ formal operations، من 11 لـ 16 سنة.

qs.q: The main question of Piaget in cognitive theory is "how do people know?" (True / False)
qs.ex: صح. سؤال بياجيه الأساسي: الناس بتعرف إزاي (how do people know).

qs.q: According to Piaget's cognitive theory, the formal operational period means that the child:
opts: Is unable to focus on more than one aspect of a situation
Has the ability to see logical relationships
Hasn't the emerging ability to think mentally
qs.ex: الـ Formal operational: الطفل يقدر يشوف العلاقات المنطقية ويفكر بشكل مجرد.

qs.q: Children can solve visual problems better than verbal problems according to Piaget's cognitive theory in the ...... stage.
qs.ex: حل المسائل المرئية أحسن من الكلامية: Concrete operational.

qs.q: Children at 12 years are able to focus on only one aspect of a situation. (True / False)
qs.ex: غلط. التركيز على جانب واحد (centration) ده في الـ preoperational. طفل 12 سنة بيقدر يشوف أكتر من جانب.

qs.q: Assimilation means understanding of a new experience so that it can change the previous understanding. (True / False)
qs.ex: غلط. اللي بيغيّر الفهم القديم اسمه accommodation. أما الـ assimilation فبيدخّل المعلومة الجديدة في الفهم القديم من غير ما يغيّره.

qs.q: According to Piaget, whatever is repeatable and generalized in an action is called:
qs.ex: الحاجة اللي بتتكرر وبتتعمم في الفعل اسمها Schema.

qs.q: A child is able to use deductive and inductive reasoning during: مصادر2 تكرر في
qs.ex: الـ Deductive والـ inductive reasoning من 11 لـ 16 سنة (formal operations).

qs.q: At which stage of cognitive development do children become able to think abstractly as well as logically?
qs.ex: التفكير المجرد والمنطقي في الـ Formal operational.

qs.q: Which of the following abilities is related to the concrete-operational stage of cognition?
qs.ex: الـ Classifying (التصنيف) من مهارات الـ concrete operational.

qs.q: Which of the following best describes Piaget's cognitive stage of formal operations?
qs.ex: الـ Formal operations: تفكير استنتاجي ومجرد (deductive and abstract).

qs.q: Which concept does Piaget use to refer to mental activities?
qs.ex: بياجيه بيسمي الأنشطة العقلية Operations.

qs.q: A child is able to use deductive and inductive reasoning during:
qs.ex: من 11 لـ 16 سنة.

qs.q: The pre-operational period according to Piaget's theory develops at the age of:
qs.ex: الـ Preoperational من 2 لـ 7 سنين.

qs.q: In terms of cognitive development, the 13-year-old child would be expected to use which thinking?
qs.ex: طفل 13 سنة بيفكر بشكل مجرد (Abstract).

qs.q: Actions such as ordering, classifying, creating, enumerating, and grouping are considered:
qs.ex: الترتيب والتصنيف والتجميع دي Mental operations.

qs.q: During which stage of cognitive development does the individual use primitive reflexes to explore the world?
qs.ex: استخدام الـ primitive reflexes لاستكشاف العالم في الـ Sensorimotor (من الولادة لسنتين).

qs.q: According to Piaget's cognitive theory, at which stage of cognitive development does the child exhibit object permanence?
qs.ex: الـ Object permanence (إن الحاجة موجودة حتى لو مش شايفها) بتظهر في الـ sensorimotor.

qs.q: Schema building occurs as a result of modifying new information to fit existing schemes and by modifying old schemes as per new information. These two processes are known as:
qs.ex: تعديل المعلومة الجديدة علشان تدخل في الـ schema اسمه assimilation، وتعديل الـ schema القديمة اسمه accommodation.

qs.q: According to Jean Piaget's theory, a child between 2 to 7 years is in the ...... stage of cognitive development.
qs.ex: من 2 لـ 7 سنين: Preoperational.

qs.q: According to Piaget's cognitive theory, the formal operational period means that the child:
opts: Hasn't the emerging ability to think mentally
Is unable to focus on more than one aspect of a situation
Has the ability to think abstractly
qs.ex: الـ Formal operational: القدرة على التفكير المجرد.

qs.q: Schema building occurs as a result of modifying new information and understanding old schemes as per new information. These two processes are known as:
qs.ex: الاتنين: Assimilation وaccommodation.

qs.q: According to Piaget's theory of cognitive development, the adolescent is in which stage?
qs.ex: المراهق في مرحلة الـ Formal operational.

qs.q: Which of the following explains the cognitive development of the individual during early adulthood?
opts: Focus on one aspect of situation
qs.ex: في بداية الرشد: القدرة على التفكير المجرد.

qs.q: A 9-month-old searches for a toy hidden under a blanket. This shows:
qs.ex: رضيع 9 شهور بيدوّر على لعبة متخبية تحت بطانية: ده Object permanence.

qs.q: A 4-year-old believes the sun follows him. This reflects:
qs.ex: طفل 4 سنين فاكر إن الشمس ماشية وراه: ده Egocentrism وتفكير سحري (preoperational).

qs.q: Select ALL abilities of the concrete operational stage.
qs.ex: مهارات الـ concrete: التصنيف (classification)، والـ conservation، والـ reversibility، والترتيب (seriation). أما التفكير الافتراضي الاستنتاجي فده formal.

qs.q: Fitting new information into an existing schema is called:
qs.ex: إدخال معلومة جديدة في schema موجودة اسمه Assimilation.

qs.q: Abstract and inductive/deductive reasoning appear in:
qs.ex: التفكير المجرد والاستقرائي والاستنتاجي: Formal operational.

qs.q: Mental actions such as ordering and classifying are termed:
qs.ex: الأفعال العقلية زي الترتيب والتصنيف اسمها Operations.

qs.q: According to Kohlberg's moral theory, children see rules as fixed and absolute at the stage of ......
qs.ex: شايف القواعد ثابتة ومطلقة: مرحلة Obedience and punishment.

qs.q: According to Kohlberg's moral theory, parents can best foster their children's moral development by:
opts: Setting high expectations for moral behavior
qs.ex: الأهل يقدروا يساعدوا ولادهم في التطور الأخلاقي لما يناقشوا معاهم معضلات أخلاقية (moral dilemmas).

qs.q: Kohlberg studied the development of moral reasoning by a set of hypothetical stories. (True / False)
qs.ex: صح. كولبرج درس التفكير الأخلاقي بقصص افتراضية، زي قصة Heinz.

qs.q: According to Kohlberg's theory, obeying the rules to avoid punishment occurs at the ...... level of moral development.
qs.ex: إطاعة القواعد علشان تتجنب العقاب: Preconventional.

qs.q: The ability of an individual to develop ethical values on which to base his/her actions is termed ...... development.
qs.ex: القدرة إن الإنسان يبني قيم أخلاقية يمشي عليها: Moral development.

qs.q: At which stage of Kohlberg's theory do children see rules as fixed and absolute?
qs.ex: القواعد ثابتة ومطلقة: Obedience and punishment orientation.

qs.q: Sara is 4 years old; she is tempted to get a doll while her mother is shopping but decides not to grab it. This behavior is in which stage of Kohlberg's moral development?
qs.ex: سارة 4 سنين، كانت عايزة تاخد العروسة ومخدتهاش، خوفاً من العقاب: Obedience/punishment orientation.

qs.q: According to Kohlberg's theory, which stage of moral development focuses on seeking approval from society and living up to social expectations?
qs.ex: إنه يدوّر على رضا المجتمع ويبقى «ولد كويس»: Interpersonal relationships.

qs.q: According to Kohlberg's moral theory, morality is influenced by one of the following:
qs.ex: الأخلاق بتتأثر بتركيبة الأسرة (Family structure).

qs.q: A child reasons "you do this for me and I'll do that for you". In which stage of Kohlberg's moral reasoning would this child fall?
qs.ex: «اعملّي دي وأنا أعملّك دي»: Individualism and exchange.

qs.q: Kohlberg's theory of moral development includes the following stages, EXCEPT:
qs.ex: الـ Primary circular reactions من بياجيه، مش من كولبرج.

qs.q: Development of the ability of an individual to distinguish right from wrong is termed ...... development.
qs.ex: التمييز بين الصح والغلط: Moral development.

qs.q: Kohlberg's final level of moral reasoning is based upon ...... مصادر3 تكرر في
qs.ex: آخر مستوى عند كولبرج: Universal ethical principles (مبادئ أخلاقية عالمية).

qs.q: According to Kohlberg, the notion of mutual exchange in which children are aware of fairness is:
qs.ex: التبادل وإن الطفل واخد باله من العدل اسمه Reciprocity. خلي بالك: الفورم الرسمي صحح justice بالغلط.

qs.q: According to Kohlberg's theory, the notion of mutual exchange in which children are aware of fairness is:
qs.ex: Reciprocity.

qs.q: The ability of an individual to distinguish right from wrong and to develop ethical values on which to base his or her actions is ......
qs.ex: القدرة على التمييز بين الصح والغلط وبناء قيم: Moral development.

qs.q: According to Kohlberg's moral theory, morality is influenced by one of the following:
qs.ex: Family structure.

qs.q: The ability of an individual to develop ethical values on which to base his actions is termed as ...... development.
qs.ex: Moral development.

qs.q: According to Kohlberg's theory, when a child obeys the rules to avoid punishment, he is in which stage?
qs.ex: إطاعة القواعد علشان يتجنب العقاب: Preconventional.

qs.q: Kohlberg's final level of moral reasoning is based upon ......
qs.ex: Universal principles.

qs.q: Which of the following methods was used by Kohlberg to study the moral development of children?
opts: Understanding children through thoughts and experience
Conducting observation of children during play
Posing moral dilemmas to children and analyzing responses
Assuming libido as a life force, a source of energy
qs.ex: كولبرج كان بيعرض على الأطفال معضلات أخلاقية ويحلل ردودهم.

qs.q: According to Kohlberg's moral development theory, morality is influenced by external factors such as ......
qs.ex: الأخلاق بتتأثر بعوامل خارجية زي العقاب والمكافأة.

qs.q: In which stage of Kohlberg's moral development do children see rules as fixed and absolute?
qs.ex: القواعد ثابتة ومطلقة: Obedience and punishment.

qs.q: A child behaves well only to avoid being punished. Kohlberg's level is:
qs.ex: بيتصرف كويس بس علشان ميتعاقبش: Preconventional.

qs.q: A school-age child follows rules to be seen as a 'good girl'. This is:
qs.ex: بتمشي على القواعد علشان تبان «بنت كويسة»: Interpersonal relationships (good boy/good girl).

qs.q: Select ALL stages of Kohlberg's theory.
qs.ex: مراحل كولبرج: Obedience and punishment، وIndividualism and exchange، وInterpersonal relationships، وMaintaining social order. الـ Primary circular reactions مش منهم.

qs.q: Kohlberg studied moral reasoning by:
qs.ex: كولبرج استخدم معضلات أخلاقية (قصص افتراضية).

qs.q: The best way parents can foster moral development is:
qs.ex: أحسن حاجة: نناقش المعضلات الأخلاقية مع الطفل ونبقى قدوة.

qs.q: The highest level of moral reasoning is based on:
qs.ex: أعلى مستوى: Universal ethical principles.

qs.q: According to Erikson's psychosocial theory, a 2-year-old child will develop a sense of
qs.ex: طفل سنتين: Autonomy versus shame and doubt (الـ toddler، من سنة لـ 3).

qs.q: According to Erikson's psychosocial theory, which response should the nurse make to a mother whose 8-year-old child seems more attentive to peers than anything else?
opts: This is abnormal behavior and needs concern
Provide more praise to the child to stop this
At this age, the child is developing his own sense of industry with peers
Monitor the child's behavior and punish him
qs.ex: طفل 8 سنين مهتم بأصحابه: ده طبيعي، لأنه في مرحلة الـ industry مع الـ peers.

qs.q: (Matching) Erikson's stage "Initiative" belongs to which period of age?
qs.ex: الـ Initiative في الـ Preschool (3–6).

qs.q: (Matching) Erikson's stage "Industry" belongs to which period of age?
qs.ex: الـ Industry في سن المدرسة (6–12).

qs.q: (Matching) Erikson's stage "Identity" belongs to which period of age?
qs.ex: الـ Identity في المراهقة.

qs.q: (Matching) Erikson's stage "Integrity" belongs to which period of age?
qs.ex: الـ Integrity في الشيخوخة (Late adulthood).

qs.q: (Matching) Erikson's stage "Autonomy" belongs to which period of age?
qs.ex: الـ Autonomy في الـ Toddler.

qs.q: The opposite sense of integrity is despair. (True / False)
qs.ex: صح. عكس الـ integrity هو despair (اليأس).

qs.q: Erikson proposed that in school age the most crucial sense to be formed is ......
qs.ex: أهم إحساس في سن المدرسة: Industry.

qs.q: A 10-year-old child who feels inadequacy and is withdrawn from peers, according to Erikson's theory, developed a sense of ......
qs.ex: طفل 10 سنين حاسس إنه ناقص ومنعزل عن صحابه: Inferiority (فشل في مرحلة الـ industry).

qs.q: When parents encourage a 5-year-old girl to ask questions and assume new activities for herself and her younger sibling, they are encouraging a sense of:
qs.ex: الأهل بيشجعوا بنت 5 سنين تسأل وتبادر بأنشطة: كده بيشجعوا الـ Initiative.

qs.q: According to Erikson's theory, which of the following senses is related to early adulthood?
qs.ex: بداية الرشد: Intimacy vs. isolation.

qs.q: According to Erikson's psychosocial theory, at which stage does a child start to tolerate separation from his/her mother?
qs.ex: الطفل بيبدأ يستحمل البعد عن مامته في مرحلة الـ Toddler.

qs.q: A 10-year-old child feels inadequate, withdrawn from peers and has no hope. According to Erikson's theory, which sense is developed?
qs.ex: Inferiority.

qs.q: According to Erikson's theory, when a mother meets the infant's needs consistently he/she will develop a sense of:
qs.ex: الأم بتلبّي احتياجات الرضيع باستمرار، فبيتكوّن عنده Trust.

qs.q: According to psychosocial development theory, the school-age child tries to develop a sense of ......
qs.ex: سن المدرسة: Industry.

qs.q: According to Erikson, the major task during adolescence is to do which of the following?
qs.ex: مهمة المراهقة الأساسية إنه يكوّن هوية (Establish an identity).

qs.q: According to Erikson, which of the following is a sense of control over the self and bodily functions?
qs.ex: الإحساس بالتحكم في النفس ووظايف الجسم اسمه Autonomy.

qs.q: According to Erikson's theory, a 5-year-old child who is repeatedly rewarded for good things has the potential for developing a sense of:
qs.ex: طفل 5 سنين بيتكافئ على الحاجات الكويسة: بيتكوّن عنده Initiative.

qs.q: According to Erikson's theory, a 13-year-old child is demonstrating which of the following characteristics?
qs.ex: طفل 13 سنة في مرحلة Identity.

qs.q: According to Erikson's theory, which developmental age child can start to tolerate separation from his/her mother?
qs.ex: الطفل بيبدأ يستحمل البعد عن أمه من سنة لـ 3 سنين.

qs.q: According to Erikson, the major task during adolescence is to do which of the following things?
qs.ex: يكوّن هوية (Establish an identity).

qs.q: According to Erikson's theory, a 7-year-old child is demonstrating which of the positive senses?
qs.ex: طفل 7 سنين: Industry.

qs.q: According to Erikson's theory, a 4-year-old child who is repeatedly rewarded for good things has the potential for developing a sense of:
qs.ex: طفل 4 سنين: Initiative.

qs.q: Which of the following characterizes the initiative sense of toddlers as Erikson stated? (virtue)
qs.ex: فضيلة الـ initiative هي Purpose. خلي بالك: السؤال كاتب toddlers، بس الـ initiative في الحقيقة مرحلة الـ preschool.

qs.q: What is the main outcome (virtue) of successfully completing the first stage of psychosocial development?
qs.ex: فضيلة أول مرحلة (trust) هي Hope.

qs.q: According to Erikson's psychosocial theory, the major conflict in the first year of life is between:
qs.ex: الصراع في أول سنة: Trust vs. mistrust.

qs.q: Which stage of psychosocial development, according to Erikson's theory, is for a 7-year-old child?
qs.ex: طفل 7 سنين: Industry vs. inferiority.

qs.q: According to Erikson's theory, a 7-year-old child is in which stage?
qs.ex: Industry vs. inferiority.

qs.q: During preschool, psychosocial development focuses on:
qs.ex: الـ Preschool: Initiative. الفورم الرسمي كان مصحح الإجابة دي غلط، بس حسب إريكسون هي الصح.

qs.q: According to Erikson's stages of psychosocial development, the adolescent is in the ___ vs. ___ stage with a ___ goal to develop.
qs.ex: المراهق في Identity vs. role confusion، والفضيلة fidelity.

qs.q: A 4-year-old child always wants to help her mother in caring for her newborn sibling; this indicates that the child is developing a sense of:
qs.ex: بنت 4 سنين عايزة تساعد مامتها في أخوها الصغير: Initiative.

qs.q: An 8-year-old child is unable to engage in meaningful and useful work in school; this indicates that the child is developing a sense of:
qs.ex: طفل 8 سنين مش قادر يعمل شغل مفيد في المدرسة: Inferiority.

qs.q: A school-age child wants to engage in tasks that he can complete in order to
qs.ex: طفل سن المدرسة عايز يخلّص مهام علشان يحس إنه قادر (feel competent)، وفضيلة الـ industry هي competence.

qs.q: According to Erikson's theory, what is the developmental task of the adolescence period?
qs.ex: المراهقة: Identity.

qs.q: A 37-year-old single man who is unable to form intimate relationships with others is experiencing a sense of:
qs.ex: راجل 37 سنة مش قادر يكوّن علاقات قريبة: Isolation.

qs.q: According to Erikson's developmental theory, if the parents encourage a little girl to ask questions, use her imagination and choose some activities, they are encouraging a sense of ......
qs.ex: تشجيع البنت تسأل وتتخيل وتختار أنشطتها: Initiative.

qs.q: What is the main outcome of successfully completing the first stage of psychosocial development?
qs.ex: فضيلة أول مرحلة: Hope.

qs.q: A 3-year-old insists on dressing herself. According to Erikson she is working on:
qs.ex: بنت 3 سنين مصممة تلبس لوحدها: Autonomy vs. shame and doubt.

qs.q: The virtue (basic strength) achieved by successfully resolving trust vs. mistrust is:
qs.ex: فضيلة الـ trust هي Hope. بعدها will، وpurpose، وcompetence، وfidelity، وlove، وcare، وwisdom.

qs.q: Select ALL correct pairings of age and Erikson stage.
qs.ex: التوصيل الصح: infant مع trust، وpreschool مع initiative، وschool age مع industry، وlate adulthood مع integrity. أما المراهق فـ identity مش intimacy.

qs.q: A 9-year-old feels incapable compared with classmates. The nurse recognizes a risk of:
qs.ex: طفل 9 سنين حاسس إنه أقل من زمايله: خطر Inferiority.

qs.q: Which intervention best promotes trust in a hospitalized infant?
opts: Consistently meeting needs for feeding and comfort
Strict feeding schedule regardless of cues
qs.ex: علشان الرضيع في المستشفى يحس بالـ trust: نلبّي احتياجاته من أكل وراحة باستمرار.

qs.q: A 50-year-old volunteering to mentor young people reflects:
qs.ex: واحد عنده 50 سنة بيتطوع يوجّه الشباب: Generativity.

qs.q: According to Freud's psychosexual theory, which of the following stages is indicated for infants?
qs.ex: الرضيع في المرحلة الفموية (Oral).

qs.q: Conflicts between neatness and sloppiness result in fixation of the phallic stage. (True / False)
qs.ex: غلط. الصراع بين النظافة والفوضى في المرحلة الشرجية (Anal)، مش الـ phallic.

qs.q: According to psychosexual development, which response should the nurse make for the mother who told that her 4-year-old child has masturbation?
opts: The child is very young to begin this behavior
This is a normal behavior at this age
The child should be seen by a doctor
Children usually begin this behavior at a later age
qs.ex: الـ masturbation عند طفل 4 سنين طبيعية في السن ده (phallic stage).

qs.q: The id is an important part of personality responsible for reality. (True / False)
qs.ex: غلط. الـ Id مسؤول عن اللذة. اللي مسؤول عن الواقع هو الـ ego.

qs.q: According to Freud's psychosexual theory, the developmental stage of school age is termed ...... stage.
qs.ex: سن المدرسة: Latency.

qs.q: According to Freud, the latency stage is achieved during which developmental stage?
qs.ex: الـ Latency في سن المدرسة.

qs.q: According to Freud's theory, the id is based on the ...... principle.
qs.ex: الـ Id شغال بمبدأ اللذة (Pleasure).

qs.q: According to Freud's theory, wishes, feelings and impulses that lie beyond awareness are in the ......
qs.ex: الرغبات والمشاعر اللي برا الوعي في الـ Unconscious.

qs.q: A 26-month-old child refuses toilet training and often shouts "No!" when given directions. According to Freud's theory, the nurse would assess the child's behavior based on which stage?
qs.ex: طفل 26 شهر رافض التدريب على الحمام وبيقول «لأ»: مرحلة Anal.

qs.q: The ego's job is to meet the needs of the id through ......
opts: Dictating beliefs of right and wrong
Considering the reality of the situation
qs.ex: الـ Ego بيلبّي احتياجات الـ id وهو واخد الواقع في اعتباره (reality principle).

qs.q: According to Freud's psychosexual theory, wishes, feelings and impulses that lie beyond awareness are in the:
qs.ex: Unconscious level.

qs.q: According to Freud's theory, which part of the personality components drives a child when he starts to consider morality?
qs.ex: الجزء المسؤول عن الأخلاق هو الـ Superego.

qs.q: Which part of the personality structure is responsible for pleasurable behavior?
qs.ex: اللذة: Id.

qs.q: According to Freud, the libidinal energy center in the toddler stage is:
qs.ex: مركز الطاقة في الـ toddler: الشرج (Anus).

qs.q: Which part of the personality structure is responsible for pleasurable behavior according to psychosexual theory?
qs.ex: Id.

qs.q: According to psychosexual development, which response should the nurse make to the mother who told that her 4-year-old child has masturbation?
opts: Children usually begin this behavior at a later age
The child is very young to begin this behavior
This is a normal behavior at this age
The child should be seen by a doctor
qs.ex: ده سلوك طبيعي في السن ده.

qs.q: According to Freud's theory, the ego is based on the ...... principle. مصادر4 تكرر في
qs.ex: الـ Ego شغال بمبدأ الواقع (Reality).

qs.q: Which of the following stages according to Freud's theory extends from 0–12 months?
qs.ex: من 0 لـ 12 شهر: المرحلة الفموية (Oral).

qs.q: According to Freud's theory, the ego is based on the ...... principle.
qs.ex: Reality.

qs.q: Which of the following explains the latency period according to the psychosexual stages of development?
opts: No psychosexual development takes place during this stage
Children's libidinal energy is reduced dramatically
Males have a tendency to develop Oedipus complex
This stage begins at puberty and constitutes mature adult sexuality
qs.ex: الـ Latency: طاقة الـ libido بتقل جداً.

qs.q: According to Freud's psychosexual theory, fixation at the oral stage may be represented as:
qs.ex: التثبيت في المرحلة الفموية بيظهر في صورة أكل زيادة.

qs.q: In the Oedipus complex a boy would feel attached to ......
qs.ex: في عقدة أوديب الولد بيتعلق بمامته.

qs.q: In which stage would there be the least conflict in the minds of children?
qs.ex: أقل صراع في الـ Latency.

qs.q: In the Electra complex a girl would feel attached to:
qs.ex: في عقدة إلكترا البنت بتتعلق بباباها.

qs.q: Which of the following explains the latency period according to the psychosexual stages of development?
opts: Libidinal energy is increased during this stage
Children's libidinal energies are reduced dramatically
Males have a tendency to develop Oedipus complex
This stage begins at puberty and constitutes mature adult sexuality
qs.ex: الـ Latency: الـ libido بيقل جداً.

qs.q: According to Freud's psychosexual theory, fixation at the oral stage may be represented as:
qs.ex: التثبيت الفموي: رغي كتير وأكل كتير.

qs.q: Which of the following indicates the psychosexual developmental stage of the preschool child?
qs.ex: الـ Preschool: Phallic.

qs.q: Which of the following stages explains the psychosexual development of the school- age child?
qs.ex: سن المدرسة: Latency.

qs.q: Which part of personality structure is responsible for pleasurable behavior?
qs.ex: Id.

qs.q: In the Oedipus complex a boy would feel attached to the ......
qs.ex: Mother.

qs.q: Which part of the personality operates on the pleasure principle?
qs.ex: الـ Id شغال بمبدأ اللذة، والـ ego بمبدأ الواقع، والـ superego بالأخلاق.

qs.q: Toilet-training conflicts belong to which psychosexual stage?
qs.ex: صراعات التدريب على الحمام في المرحلة الشرجية (Anal).

qs.q: Select ALL features of the phallic stage.
qs.ex: الـ phallic: سن 3–6 تقريباً، وفيها عقدة أوديب وإلكترا، والـ masturbation ممكن تبقى طبيعية، والتركيز على الأعضاء التناسلية. أما الـ libido الهادي فده latency.

qs.q: Fixation at the oral stage may appear in adulthood as:
qs.ex: التثبيت الفموي: أكل زيادة، وتدخين، وقضم ضوافر.

qs.q: Wishes and impulses outside awareness are found in the:
qs.ex: الـ Unconscious.

qs.q: Which stage has the least psychological conflict?
qs.ex: أقل صراع: Latency.

qs.q: Denver II screening test includes ......
opts: Communication skills, physical, academic and social
Organization, play materials, parental control and stimulation
Personal-social, fine motor-adaptive, language and gross motor
Intellectual, memory, quantitative and perceptual performance
qs.ex: الـ Denver II بيقيس 4 حاجات: Personal-social، وFine motor-adaptive، وLanguage، وGross motor.

qs.q: The nurse answers the mother's question about the number of words of a 4-year-old child:
qs.ex: طفل 4 سنين عنده حوالي 1500 كلمة.

qs.q: Early detection of problems is one of the purposes of developmental assessment. (True / False)
qs.ex: صح. من أهداف التقييم التطوري إننا نكتشف المشاكل بدري.

qs.q: In terms of fine motor development, what could the three-year-old child be expected to do?
qs.ex: طفل 3 سنين يقدر يرسم دايرة (circle). ربط الجزمة واستخدام المقص ورسم شخص بييجوا بعد كده.

qs.q: Denver II is a screening test used for children from birth to ...... years.
qs.ex: الـ Denver II من الولادة لـ 6 سنين.

qs.q: Which of the following neuromuscular developments is related to gross motor in the Denver II test?
qs.ex: النط على رجل واحدة (hop) ده gross motor. الباقي fine motor.

qs.q: Developmental and growth assessment can be administered only in one setting. (True / False)
qs.ex: غلط. التقييم ممكن يتعمل في أي مكان: البيت، والعيادة، والمستشفى.

qs.q: Denver Test II is used to assess the child's ...... development from birth to six years.
qs.ex: بيقيّم التطور العصبي العضلي (Neuromuscular).

qs.q: The nurse is evaluating the motor developmental level of a 2-year-old. Which of the following does the nurse expect to observe?
qs.ex: طفل سنتين بيقلّد الخطوط الرأسية (vertical lines). الخطوط الأفقية والوقوف على رجل واحدة بييجوا بعدها.

qs.q: The nurse realizes that a 5-year-old's mother needs further education about the Denver Developmental Screening Test when she states it screens for:
qs.ex: الـ Denver مش بيقيس الذكاء (IQ). لو الأم قالت كده تبقى محتاجة توعية.

qs.q: Denver II test is used to assess the child's ...... development from birth to six years.
qs.ex: Neuromuscular.

qs.q: In percentile growth curves, measurement below ...... is considered smaller than the normal curve.
qs.ex: حسب البنك: لو القياس أقل من الـ percentile الـ 10 يبقى أصغر من الطبيعي.

qs.q: The Denver II screens children from birth to:
qs.ex: من الولادة لـ 6 سنين.

qs.q: Select ALL areas assessed by Denver II.
qs.ex: الـ Denver II بيقيس: personal-social، وfine motor، وlanguage، وgross motor. ومبيقيسش الذكاء.

qs.q: A mother asks whether Denver II measures her child's IQ. The best response:
opts: Yes, it gives an IQ score
No, it screens developmental delays, not intelligence
qs.ex: لأ، ده اختبار screening بيكتشف التأخر في التطور، مش بيقيس الذكاء.

qs.q: On a growth chart, measurements below which percentile suggest a problem?
qs.ex: أقل من الـ percentile الـ 10 (أو الـ 5) محتاج تقييم.

qs.q: Which is a gross motor item on the Denver II?
qs.ex: النط على رجل واحدة gross motor.

qs.q: A purpose of developmental assessment is:
qs.ex: اكتشاف المشاكل بدري.

qs.q: What should the nurse do when the total Apgar score for a newborn is 3?
qs.ex: Apgar 3 معناه حالة شديدة ومحتاج إنعاش (resuscitation).

qs.q: The nurse immediately dries the newborn from amniotic fluid to conserve the neonate's heat, which of the following methods?
qs.ex: تنشيف المولود من السائل الأمنيوسي بيمنع فقد الحرارة بالـ Evaporation (التبخر).

qs.q: Neonatal reflexes that are present at birth represent the first features of adaptation. (True / False)
qs.ex: صح. الـ reflexes الموجودة من الولادة أول علامات التكيف.

qs.q: An infant who had an Apgar score of six indicates ...... difficulty adjusting to extra-uterine life.
qs.ex: Apgar من 4 لـ 6 معناه صعوبة متوسطة (moderate).

qs.q: The nurse should prevent heat loss in the newborn infant resulting from evaporation by:
opts: Turning on the overhead radiant warmer
Closing the doors to the room
Drying the infant with a warm blanket
qs.ex: علشان نمنع الـ evaporation ننشّفه ببطانية دافية.

qs.q: The first factor that fosters initial breathing after birth is:
qs.ex: أول عامل بيبدأ التنفس: الميكانيكي (ضغط القناة المهبلية على الصدر وبعدين الصدر بيرجع يتفرد).

qs.q: The nurse should prevent heat loss in the newborn resulting from evaporation by:
opts: Drying the infant with a warm blanket
Closing the doors to the room
Turning on the overhead radiant warmer
qs.ex: ننشّفه ببطانية دافية.

qs.q: Metabolism of brown fat in the newborn helps them adapt to room temperature. (True / False)
qs.ex: صح. حرق الدهون البني (brown fat) بيطلّع حرارة بتساعد المولود يتأقلم.

qs.q: Which of the following factors increases the susceptibility to heat loss in neonates?
opts: Increased ability to control their metabolic rate
Increased insulation due to a lot of fat
Blood vessels of the newborn are deeper in the muscle
qs.ex: مساحة جسم المولود كبيرة بالنسبة لوزنه، فبيفقد حرارة بسرعة.

qs.q: While the newborn loses heat from the amniotic fluid immediately after birth, this method of heat loss is called ......
qs.ex: فقد الحرارة من السائل اللي على جسمه: Evaporation.

qs.q: The ductus venosus constricts in response to:
opts: Clamping of the umbilical cord after birth
Increased oxygen and decreased resistance in lungs
Increased pressure in the left side of the heart
qs.ex: الـ ductus venosus بيقفل بعد ما الحبل السري يتقطع.

qs.q: Which of the following is the mechanical factor that influences initiation of the first breath after birth?
qs.ex: العامل الميكانيكي: ضغط القناة المهبلية (vaginal squeezing).

qs.q: Which of the following is a function of brown adipose tissue (BAT) in the newborn?
opts: Generates heat for distribution to other parts of the body
Provides a ready source of calories in the newborn period
Protects the infant from injury during the birth process
Insulates the body against lowered environmental temperature
qs.ex: الدهون البني بتطلّع حرارة وبتوزعها على الجسم.

qs.q: The Apgar score is used to determine which of the following?
opts: Major body system's response at birth
Level of parent and newborn interaction
qs.ex: الـ Apgar بيقيس استجابة أجهزة الجسم الأساسية وقت الولادة.

qs.q: Placing an infant in the direct flow of air from a fan causes rapid heat loss through:
qs.ex: هوا المروحة: Convection.

qs.q: One of the earliest indicators of successful adaptation of the newborn is the APGAR score; when the score is 3 this means the newborn requires:
qs.ex: Apgar 3 محتاج إنعاش.

qs.q: Which is the MECHANICAL stimulus for the first breath?
opts: Vaginal squeeze followed by chest recoil
qs.ex: المحفز الميكانيكي: الصدر بيتضغط في القناة المهبلية وبعدين بيرجع يتفرد، فالهوا بيدخل.

qs.q: The ductus venosus closes because:
qs.ex: الـ ductus venosus بيقفل لأن الحبل السري اتقطع فالدم وقف ييجي منه.

qs.q: Select ALL methods to prevent neonatal heat loss.
qs.ex: طرق منع فقد الحرارة: ننشّفه، وندفّي الأسطح والميزان، ونبعّده عن التيارات، ونحطه تحت الـ radiant warmer. أما الحمام بعد الولادة على طول فغلط.

qs.q: Brown adipose tissue in the newborn mainly:
qs.ex: الدهون البني بتطلّع حرارة من غير رعشة (non-shivering thermogenesis).

qs.q: An Apgar score of 3 at 1 minute indicates:
qs.ex: Apgar 3: حالة شديدة ومحتاج إنعاش. (0–3 شديد، 4–6 متوسط، 7–10 كويس).

qs.q: The foramen ovale closes functionally because:
opts: Left atrial pressure becomes higher than right
qs.ex: الـ foramen ovale بيقفل لأن ضغط الأذين الشمال بيبقى أعلى من اليمين بعد ما الرئة تشتغل.

qs.q: Which of the following statements describes caput succedaneum in newborns?
opts: Increase in size on second day
Swelling of soft tissue across suture line
qs.ex: الـ Caput succedaneum: تورم في الأنسجة الطرية بيعدّي خطوط الـ sutures. أما الـ cephalhematoma فدم تحت غشاء العضم ومبيعديش الـ sutures.

qs.q: The newborn infant loses about ...... of birth weight in the first week after birth.
qs.ex: المولود بيخس 5–10% من وزنه في أول أسبوع، وبيرجّعهم في 10–14 يوم.

qs.q: Which of the following reflexes is stimulated by a sudden loud sound?
qs.ex: الصوت العالي المفاجئ بيطلّع الـ Moro reflex.

qs.q: The normal average head circumference at birth is ...... cm.
qs.ex: متوسط محيط الراس وقت الولادة 35 سم (33–35).

qs.q: The expected time for the umbilical cord to drop off is ...... days.
qs.ex: السرة بتقع بعد 7–10 أيام.

qs.q: Which instruction does the nurse give to the mother about newborn breast engorgement?
qs.ex: تضخم ثدي المولود بيروح لوحده، فممنوع نعصره.

qs.q: The newborn loses about ...... of birth weight in the first week after birth. مصادر2 تكرر في
What term describes irregular areas of deep blue pigmentation seen predominantly in newborns?
qs.ex: البقع الزرقا الغامقة: Mongolian spots.

qs.q: Tonic neck reflex is described as: placing the infant in a supine position with lateral rotation of the head to one side. (True / False)
qs.ex: صح. الـ Tonic neck reflex: الطفل على ضهره، ولما راسه تلف لناحية الدراع اللي في الناحية دي بيتفرد.

qs.q: Facial stimulation by a puff of air induces swallowing and esophageal peristalsis in a healthy infant, called the Santmyer swallow reflex. (True / False)
qs.ex: صح. نفخة هوا على الوش بتعمل بلع: Santmyer swallow reflex.

qs.q: Which of the following is true about Mongolian spots?
qs.ex: الـ Mongolian spots بتختفي غالباً في حدود سنة (أو لحد 4 سنين). مش علامة إيذاء ومش محتاجة علاج.

qs.q: Milia is yellow spots that appear on the newborn's back. (True / False)
qs.ex: غلط. الـ milia حبيبات بيضا أو صفرا صغيرة على المناخير والدقن، مش على الضهر.

qs.q: The mother asked the nurse "what is the importance of the greasy whitish substance that covers the newborn skin?" The nurse's best response is to ......
qs.ex: المادة البيضا الدهنية (vernix) بتحمي من العدوى.

qs.q: A sudden loud noise in the surrounding area of a newborn infant is likely to elicit which reflex?
qs.ex: Moro.

qs.q: What term describes irregular areas of deep blue pigmentation seen predominantly in the lower back and buttocks of newborns?
qs.ex: Mongolian spots.

qs.q: The newborn loses about ...... of birth weight in the first week after birth.
When a baby is held upright with his/her feet touching a solid surface, the baby is likely to provoke which reflex?
qs.ex: لما رجليه تلمس سطح وهو واقف: Stepping reflex.

qs.q: A newborn's skin is covered with a greasy whitish cheesy substance, known as ......
qs.ex: المادة البيضا الجبنية اسمها Vernix caseosa.

qs.q: A swelling of the newborn scalp that crosses suture lines is:
qs.ex: تورم في فروة الراس بيعدّي خطوط الـ sutures: Caput succedaneum.

qs.q: Bluish-gray patches over the lower back of a newborn are:
qs.ex: بقع رمادي مزرق في أسفل الضهر: Mongolian spots.

qs.q: Select ALL normal newborn reflexes.
qs.ex: reflexes طبيعية: Moro، وRooting، وBabinski، وStepping. غياب المص مش طبيعي.
